Why It Works
Built for Active Dogs & Their People

One Flip. Instant Bowl.

The soft silicone panel flips up in a single move to form a stable drinking trough. Tilt and pour while keeping hold of the leash — no fumbling required.

  • Folds flat when not in use — zero bulk
  • Gentle soft silicone, safe on your dog's snout
  • Works as a food bowl for kibble & treats too
  • One-hand operation

Four Parts. One Perfect Bottle.

Multi-layer leak-proof seal, collapsible silicone bowl, food-grade stainless canteen, and a lanyard with snap hook — everything your dog needs in one compact unit.

  • Multi-layer tight seal — bag & backpack safe
  • Snap hook lanyard clips to harness or bag
  • 304 stainless steel: food grade & impact resistant
  • Cute printed decals on the steel body

Fits in Your Palm. Goes Everywhere.

Lightweight and compact enough to clip to a harness, slot into a cup holder, or tuck in a pocket. Carry it hands-free with the woven lanyard.

  • Fits standard car cup holders
  • Carry lanyard — no bag needed
  • Rounded form sits naturally in one hand
  • Dishwasher safe on low heat

Clips Right to the Harness.

The snap hook lanyard lets your dog carry their own water. Clips securely to any harness D-ring, backpack strap, or stroller frame.

  • Snap hook rated for daily outdoor use
  • "Love with Style" woven lanyard tag

  • Perfect for trails, beaches & dog parks

FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What colors and patterns are available? ▾
Four options: Pink Plain, Pink Bow Print, Blue Plain, and Blue Bow Tie Print. Specify your choice at checkout or email support@safebabybath.com after ordering.
Is it truly leak-proof? ▾
Yes. A multi-layer reinforced sealing mechanism creates a tight closure preventing leaks and backflow. Completely safe to carry in any bag or backpack.
Is it dishwasher safe? ▾
The silicone bowl is dishwasher safe on a low-heat cycle. We recommend hand-washing the stainless steel canteen to preserve the finish and printed decals.
How do I use the silicone bowl? ▾
1. Flip up the silicone panel to form the bowl. 2. Pull the lid open and tilt to pour water in. 3. Gently tilt the bottle to let remaining water run back. 4. Put the lid back on and press the bowl down to secure it.
Can the bowl hold food too? ▾
Yes — the silicone bowl works just as well for dry kibble or treats, making it a complete on-the-go feeding solution.
How long does shipping take? ▾
Orders ship within 1–3 business days. Delivery is 7–14 business days for the US, 10–20 days internationally. Tracking info emailed after dispatch. Shipping is free on all orders.
What is the return policy? ▾
30-day return window from delivery. Not satisfied for any reason — email support@safebabybath.com and we'll arrange a return, replacement, or full refund.
